title: EvidenceProvenanceAttestation Contract
description: S8 (spec MAWS-SII-TARGET-SPEC-001 v0.2.0, PROPOSED): the attestation that binds one behavioral evaluation to the immutable execution results it claims to come from. A behavioral eval record is a RECEIPT; a receipt is not verification. This attestation is the trace: the record is read from the canonical evidence surface (never supplied by the caller), it satisfies its own content seal, the corpus it names is re-hashed from disk, the evaluation is RE-EXECUTED over that corpus and must reproduce the record field for field, and the comparison AND the verdict are re-derived from the baseline record on disk. A record that does not reproduce carries no evidence. Receipt != Verification: the attestation proves that a receipt reproduces; it grants no permission, no qualification and no authority.

record_ref.description: The canonical evidence-surface reference of the record that was read from disk. A reference is not a path into an arbitrary tree: it names a file of the governed evidence surface.

record_digest.description: The digest of the canonical form of the record as read from the evidence surface. It binds the attestation to the exact artifact that was verified, including its creation time. It is a digest of the parsed record, not of the file bytes: a reformatting of the file leaves it unchanged.

content_digest.description: The record's own content seal, recomputed. The seal is an UNKEYED digest over the record without its creation time, so it detects an edit that was not re-sealed; it is not an authenticity property, and a re-sealed forgery is caught by the re-execution, not by the seal.

corpus_ref.description: The canonical corpus-surface reference the evaluation was re-executed over.

corpus_digest.description: The digest of the whole corpus, recomputed from its files on disk. A corpus that moved under the record changes this digest and breaks the binding.

baseline_record_ref.description: The canonical evidence-surface reference of the baseline record the verdict was re-derived from.

baseline_record_digest.description: The whole-record digest of the baseline record on disk.

verdict.description: The re-derived verdict. A BLOCKED evaluation never reaches an attestation.

subject_ref.description: The subject the evaluation measured. It is the corpus subject AND the record subject AND the promoted skill.

created_at.description: The creation time the record DECLARES. The content seal does not cover it, so this is a declared property, not an authenticated one; the gate refuses a declaration outside the age bound and a declaration from the future.

execution_mode.description: Only a recorded_replay evaluation is deterministic enough to be re-executed. A live_model record is refused instead of being accepted unverified.

execution_rederived.description: The evaluation was re-executed over the corpus and reproduced the record field for field.

comparison_rederived.description: The comparison AND the verdict were re-derived from the baseline record on disk.

runner_ref.description: The canonical runner that produces and re-executes the evaluation, so a receipt names the code that reproduces it.

runner_digest.description: The digest of the canonical runner source, bound to the attestation. A runner that cannot be read is a named refusal, not an empty field.
